report.summary: 4 findings: 1 confirmed (KillSwitch.clear() not resetting self._tripped), 1 narrowed (env restoration edge case), 2 needs-evidence (session lifecycle, stale-index detection). Prioritize critical confirmed bug, then high-severity needs-evidence items, then low-severity narrowed.
risks: Session class may not exist or may be defined elsewhere; step depends on finding its definition.
search() wrapper may not be used by any consumer; stale-index detection gap may be irrelevant.
env restoration edge case may be harmless in practice if no consumer distinguishes empty from missing.
todos: Fix KillSwitch.clear() to reset self._tripped to False.
Verify session attributes are initialized; add None-checks if needed.
Audit picker and other modules for use of search() vs search_report.
Trace env var consumers to confirm if empty string vs missing matters.

items.title: Fix KillSwitch.clear() to reset self._tripped
items.why_now: Confirmed critical bug: clear() deletes marker files but leaves self._tripped=True, causing subsequent reads to indicate tripped state incorrectly. This breaks kill switch semantics and could prevent loop restart.

steps.do: Locate clear() method in daedalus/spine/killswitch.py (likely around lines 633-639). Add line: self._tripped = False after deleting marker files.
steps.verified_by: Run `grep -A 10 'def clear' daedalus/spine/killswitch.py` to see the method; then run tests/test_killswitch.py to verify clear() resets state.

items.assumption: clear() method exists in killswitch.py as described.

items.title: Verify session attribute initialization and add None-checks
items.why_now: High severity needs-evidence: subprocess_adapter.py accesses session.timeout_s, started_at, cwd without None-check. If any session object lacks these attributes, AttributeError occurs, crashing the adapter.

steps.do: Search for Session class definition: grep -rn 'class Session' daedalus/
steps.verified_by: Command returns file path; inspect class to see if attributes have defaults.

steps.do: If Session class missing defaults, add None-check in subprocess_adapter.py events method before accessing attributes, or ensure creation paths set them.
steps.verified_by: Run tests that exercise subprocess_adapter with various session objects; no AttributeError.

items.assumption: Session class is defined in daedalus/council/session.py; if not, adjust path.

items.title: Audit picker and consumers for search() vs search_report usage
items.why_now: High severity needs-evidence: if picker uses search() wrapper instead of search_report, it loses freshness info and may use stale embeddings.

steps.do: Search for calls to 'search(' in picker and other modules: grep -rn 'search(' daedalus/spine/picker.py daedalus/memory/
steps.verified_by: Command output shows whether search() is used.

steps.do: If any consumer uses search(), verify they also check freshness via other means; if not, add freshness check or switch to search_report.
steps.verified_by: Run tests/test_picker_work_queue.py and test_embeddings.py; ensure no stale index used.

items.assumption: search() wrapper is defined in embeddings.py; search_report is the main API.

items.title: Trace env var consumers and fix restoration if needed
items.why_now: Low severity narrowed: if prior_env is empty string, restoration sets to empty instead of deleting key; some consumers may treat empty differently from missing.

steps.do: Find all consumers of DAEDALUS_TRACE_ID: grep -rn 'DAEDALUS_TRACE_ID' daedalus/
steps.verified_by: Command returns list of files; inspect each to see if they distinguish empty from missing.

steps.do: If any consumer treats empty as set, change restoration to delete key when prior_env is empty string.
steps.verified_by: Run tests that exercise env restoration; ensure trace attribution correct.

items.assumption: The env variable restoration code is in a file under daedalus/; exact path not given.
